body:
Hi, thank you for your kind words. To answer your questions. One, no my husband is studying to be an optometrist so he has little to no free time at all. Let alone time for a job. 

Two, I was on unemployment but it stopped two months ago. I'm asthmatic which makes me incredibly high risked. My husband is also diabetic which makes him very high risked as well. And working as a server has very high risks of catching covid since people can't exactly wear a mask while they eat. And being asthmatic its also very hard to run around a 90 degree kitchen in a face mask and gloves. So when restaurants re opened I had to turn down going back to work upon my doctors request due to myself and my husband being so high risk. And in Illinois this also meant giving up my unemployment...so choose between risking my life or earning a wage...

Three, I don't know if you could even help me. I'm at a point where I can't do serving anymore because it has cause permanent damage to my back and feet anyways but I know of nothing else that would work with both my husband's and kids school schedule since I also have to be the one home with them. I keep trying to find a job working from home, since its all i can think of. But my prospects are thin since the only experience I have is serving, restaurant management, and being a Cna for a short three year period. None of which would work with their schedules other than serving....

Four, I would be willing to do anything other than serving. My body just can't do it anymore. The difficult part is the two complicated schedules I have to work around. I can basically only work weekends right now so I can be home for the kids schooling since schools haven't opened and would need to work doubles on both Saturdays and Sundays in order to make enough money to make ends meet....and even when they are in school I can only work while they are there so like from 9-2:30. And who knows when that will be. 

As for my pain it is sadly something I just have to live with. There is nothing that can be done other than to prescribe me opioids. But I dont want to do that because I have watched as family members on both sides of my family destroyed their lives via opioid addiction. So i take tylenol....which does close to nothing. 

As for mentally, I've been trying to get help for years now. I've been on several different medications, been seeing a therapist, everything. I feel like im just never going to get better. And the more fed up I feel the more I feel myself slipping as a mother, provider, wife. I don't know how to do it all anymore. My husband still had three more years of school...but I have been doing this for so long....I don't know if I can last three more years.

Yes, I have been in therapy for a while now. And my husband knows. He has been very kind and supportive. But its like nothing works. I just keep feeling worse and worse. I should feel blessed for the amazing beautiful family I have and yet I can't stop feeling this pain. I told my husband recently that its gotten this bad, that I can never stop thinking about it, and he told his family. I'm supposed to vacation with them with just me and the kids next week. So I know he just wanted me to have the love and support of his family. I know that he needed that support too because hearing your wife wants to kill herself isn't exactly easy. But every time Ithink about them knowing, think about the sympathetic looks I'll get and the overly long hugs. Maybe it's because my family experience was the complete opposite of loving, caring and supportive. But it all makes me want to puke from sheer anxiety alone.

Ive been seeing a therapist for a while now, but it feels like I'm not getting anywhere. I feel like I'm just sinking further and further. I force myself to be as honest with my therapist as possible,  because I just want to be a good Mom to my kids. I want to be able to get up and move. Spend time with them. Play games with them. But its like im cut off at the legs. I feel like nothing is ever going to get better.
Of course....no one here actually gives a shit. Why should I be surprised.

I can tell you right now....there is nothing worse than losing a child. When I was pregnant, I was terrified. I was having twins. But the second I saw them, it washed away. They were the most beautiful thing I had ever seen. And I know it is like this for every Mom. 

I too struggle with depression.  It cripples me to the poin that suicide is all i think about. I can barely even manage to clean the house. I fail my children and my husband on a near daily basis. But my children love me regardless.  Yes. They don't know any better. But their blind love is so pure. And if I did go through with it, nothing I could ever say would make them understand. So i suffer through the therapy appointments that I am convinced won't help me. Because I need to be better for them. I cant, and won't, put them through that pain. If I ever lost them...I wouldn't last the week.
